newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone shares up, Henderson positive.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone shares up, Henderson positive.

text.p: Shares in Vodafone Group Plc climbed on Wednesday after analysts at Henderson Crosthwaite restated their positive stance on the stock at a dinner for investors on Tuesday evening, dealers said.
Vodafone shares climbed eight pence to 297 by 1513 GMT in volume of 7.2 million shares.
Henderson Crosthwaite analyst Patrick Hickey said he remained bullish on the stock and had presented this view to the investors' dinner.
"The shares are up after the Henderson dinner," one market-maker said.
